mapper.select: SELECT r.*, ctd.name AS cylinderTypeName, c.contract_no AS contractNo, u.unit_name AS unitName, usr.real_name AS registeredByName FROM contract_cylinder_register r LEFT JOIN cylinder_type_dict ctd ON r.cylinder_type_id = ctd.cylinder_type_id LEFT JOIN contract c ON r.contract_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id LEFT JOIN user usr ON r.registered_by = usr.id WHERE r.cylinder_no = #{cylinderNo}

SELECT r.*, ctd.name AS cylinderTypeName, c.contract_no AS contractNo, u.unit_name AS unitName FROM contract_cylinder_register r LEFT JOIN cylinder_type_dict ctd ON r.cylinder_type_id = ctd.cylinder_type_id LEFT JOIN contract c ON r.contract_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE r.cylinder_status = 1 AND r.next_inspect_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY r.next_inspect_date ASC

SELECT r.*, ctd.name AS cylinderTypeName, c.contract_no AS contractNo, u.unit_name AS unitName FROM contract_cylinder_register r LEFT JOIN cylinder_type_dict ctd ON r.cylinder_type_id = ctd.cylinder_type_id LEFT JOIN contract c ON r.contract_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON c.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE r.cylinder_status IN (1, 2) AND r.next_inspect_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY r.next_inspect_date ASC

SELECT r.*, ctd.name AS cylinderTypeName FROM contract_cylinder_register r LEFT JOIN cylinder_type_dict ctd ON r.cylinder_type_id = ctd.cylinder_type_id WHERE r.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY r.registered_at ASC
